key_insight: Test-Time Baking (TTB) compresses global scene information from cross-view attention into a lightweight MLP. This aims to make novel-view rendering fast while preserving high visual quality.
problem_solved: Decoder-only Large View Synthesis Models achieve high-quality rendering without explicit 3D reconstruction, but their attention and KV-cache mechanisms incur computational costs. Existing Test-Time Training layers reduce computation at the expense of rendering quality.
method: Use global scene information captured by cross-view attention in a decoder-only view synthesis model.
Learn to bake that information into a lightweight multilayer perceptron at test time.
Use the baked representation for efficient novel-view decoding; further implementation details are not available in the provided abstract excerpt.
impact: TTB targets a better speed–quality trade-off for neural novel-view rendering, potentially making high-fidelity view synthesis more practical. The provided excerpt does not include quantitative results.

paper_title: TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models
